videos.text: The Sunk Cost Trap You're Stuck In Psychologists just confirmed what most people refuse to believe. The research is clear on this one. Your instincts were right to be suspicious. Cognitive research shows your brain prefers the easy answer — and that preference is exactly what gets used against you. The scariest part? It works silently. No raised voice, no threats — just a pattern repeated until it feels normal. That's the real danger. Follow Cognitive Dark — the dark side of the human mind, decoded daily.
